Hi Alex -

Thanks for trying the Docs Quickstart and for the interest. I'm Marissa on the inbound team - happy to get a technical demo set up so we can walk through your specific workflows and the performance/private deployment options.

A few quick questions so we tailor the session:
- What are the primary APIs/flows you tried in the quickstart?
- Are you evaluating hosted vs private on-prem/VPC? Any compliance constraints (SOC2, data residency)?
- Will any engineers be joining the call for a deep-dive?

I've included a short pre-demo questionnaire (attached) - no need to fill everything, just the bits that help prioritize the demo.

Here are a couple of times that work on my side (PT):
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00-11:00 AM PT
- Thu Dec 3, 9:00-9:45 AM PT
- Thu Dec 3, 2:00-2:45 PM PT

Or you can pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Thanks - I'll loop in Steph (AE) to cover pricing/scale once we lock availability. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment: pre-demo-questions.docx (1 page)
From: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Docs Quickstart - Request for Technical Demo

Hi Marissa -

Thanks - excited to move forward. I ran the quickstart locally and tested the streaming generation and embeddings flow. We're most interested in latency and cost for batch inference, and also how Redwood would look in a VPC/private deployment (we have some PII coming through).

Priya (our ML infra engineer) will join the call - priya@acme-analytics.com. We prefer the Dec 2, 10:00-11:00 AM PT slot if that's still available.

A couple quick asks for the demo so we can prep internally:
- Can you cover the on-prem/VPC deployment architecture at a high level and what evidence is available for compliance?
- Any guidance you can share ahead of time on recommended quantization/runtime profiles for MLU/GPU workloads would be helpful.

Thanks - looking forward to the session.

--
Alex Chen
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Analytics
alex@acme-analytics.com

- 15 min live walkthrough: serving runtime, batching/caching, and sample latency/cost profiles
- 10 min architecture: Dedicated vs Private (VPC/on-prem) and compliance integrations (KMS/HSM, audit logs)
- 10 min implementation plan and next steps (pilot vs POC)

Files attached: tech-demo-agenda.pdf, infra-checklist.xlsx

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/ACME-157

If you can share any specific workloads or sample payload sizes Priya expects to test, we'll bring relevant perf numbers and a short runbook.

Thanks - Steph will cover pricing/commit options near the end of the call. Looking forward to meeting you both.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com
